contributions.detail: TWO Schedule A sheets, each gated on its OWN printed 'Subtotal for this page' first. Sheet 1 (p2, 15 rows): 300 + 500 + 50 + 10 + 50 + 25 + 50 + 100 + 50 + 50 + 50 + 5 + 25 + 20 + 50 = 1,335 = its printed subtotal 1335 exactly. Sheet 2 (p3, 7 rows): 50 + 50 + 100 + 15 + 48.06 + 38.35 + 96.52 = 397.93 = its printed subtotal 397.93 exactly. 1,335 + 397.93 = 1,732.93 = the printed sum-of-all-pages total AND the promoted PER-PERIOD cell Box B. Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' prints 19187.93 and is NOT summed as an increment — it carries earlier periods this report never itemizes. On sheet 1 the filer wrote 'see next page' where the sum-of-all-pages total goes, so the two footers are not redundant here and each was tested separately. Both in-kind conventions tested: no row carries an in-kind marker and the v. 4.20 form prints no in-kind line, so they are the same sum.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' (8566.53) on the p6 SUMMARY PAGE, which equals Schedule B's own printed 'Total Expenditures Made - Sum of all Schedule B pages in this report' (8566.53) on the second Schedule B sheet
expenditures.detail: TWO Schedule B sheets, each gated on its own printed page subtotal. Sheet 1 (p4, 15 rows): 45.15 + 614.41 + 1051.28 + 17.40 + 363.28 + 202.00 + 50 + (-76.47) + 350 + (-188.69) + 40.11 + 4398.23 + 100 + 45 + 104.21 = 7,115.91 = its printed subtotal 7115.91 exactly. Sheet 2 (p5, 5 rows): 10 + 15.97 + 389 + 3.65 + 1032 = 1,450.62 = its printed subtotal 1450.62 exactly. 7,115.91 + 1,450.62 = 8,566.53 = the printed sum-of-all-pages total AND Box D. THE FIRST SHEET CLOSES ONLY WITH TWO NEGATIVE ROWS KEPT NEGATIVE — rows 8 (-76.47) and 10 (-188.69), each printed with an explicit leading minus and the purpose '(refund)'; taking them positive puts the sheet 530.32 over. Box E YTD 16293.42 is the cumulative and is never summed. The filer's own ladder is internally consistent: Box F 11461.04 = Box A 9728.11 + Box B 1732.93, and the close balance 2894.51 = F - D.

itemized.notes: ADAM POMEROY, 2022, Utah County Attorney, modern_boxAF rev 'v. 4.20'. Born-digital typed fillable form, digitally signed ('Digitally signed by Adam Pomeroy / Reason: I authorize this signature / Date: 2022-07-05 17:38:14'), printed and re-scanned; every figure is machine type. *** THE 2022 FORM, CHARACTERISED (first 2022 filing of this chunk) *** SIX pages, each classified from its own printed header: p1 cover, p2 AND p3 both 'Schedule A - Itemized Contributions Received', p4 AND p5 both 'Schedule B - Itemized Expenditures Made', p6 'Summary Page' LAST. (1) THE SCHEDULES RUN TO MULTIPLE SHEETS and the two printed footers therefore do DIFFERENT work: on the first sheet of each schedule the filer wrote 'see next page' in the sum-of-all-pages Total line and put the real page figure in 'Subtotal for this page'; the last sheet of each schedule carries both. Each sheet was reconciled on its own subtotal first, then the sheets were added to the printed grand total. (2) The grid is still a FULLY BOXED 15-row grid, but the PITCH IS TIGHTER than 2020/2021 (~4.22 vs ~4.35), so the row count was counted on each page rather than carried over. (3) SCHEDULE B HAS A REAL PURPOSE COLUMN and all 20 rows fill it, including two rows whose purpose is the single word '(refund)'. (4) The cover carries the same FIVE report types as the 2021 blank (including 'Seven days preceding Convention'); '30 Days after withdrawal or elimination' is filled and the amendment question is answered No. (5) FOLIATION IS COMPLETE AND COVER-COUNTED — the Page box reads 1/6, 2/6, 3/6, 4/6, 5/6, 6/6 — which independently confirms the retained document is whole. (6) NO CHECKLIST IS BOUND INTO THIS FILING: all six pages are report pages and only p6 carries the summary labels, each with a figure. (7) TWO BLANK VINTAGES ARE MIXED WITHIN THE ONE FILING AGAIN: pp1, 4 and 5 carry the 'Josh Daniels Clerk/Auditor' masthead, pp2, 3 and 6 the older 'Amelia Powers Gardner' masthead — the addendum-F6 independent-stocking property. A NEW CAUSE OF A BLANK DONOR CITY/STATE, seen on 20 of the 22 contribution rows: the 'Address and Zip Code' cell contains the single word 'online' — a payment channel, not an address at all — so city and state are honestly blank for a reason distinct from the seven already catalogued (redacted by the county; left empty by the filer; a zip and no city; lost in reproduction; a city and zip but no state; the document has no address field; the cell holds something that is not an address, e.g. 'Paypal'). This is nearest the last of those but is worth its own note because it recurs on a whole schedule. Two further rows print only the word 'Utah', giving a state with no city. Columns were assigned by CONTENT as well as position (field-shift screen): every date cell holds a date, every name cell a person or organisation, every purpose cell a purpose — no inversion, though ONE vendor cell names an event rather than a payee (p5 row 1, 'Meet&Greet PG Elementary') and is flagged rather than reinterpreted.
